ferrers_diagnostic.conclusion: The fresh engine×world survival relation is not representable as a single nested chain under any total ordering of all three engine neighborhoods. The deterministic one-scalar world-difficulty plus globally ordered engine-threshold rival is rejected on the observed fresh ecology.

scientific_conclusion: P18's exact Stockfish⊆Berserk⊆Ethereal nesting was a development-ecology regularity, not a transportable exact law.
Fresh inversion witnesses occur in different source ecologies: Stockfish-only over Berserk in Olympiad and Berserk-only over Ethereal in Candidates.
The Ethereal low-complexity non-REDUCED sufficient candidate fails prospectively because Candidates precision is 0.60 < 0.70.
Order-free Ferrers diagnostics also fail for Stockfish/Berserk and Berserk/Ethereal, so changing the engine order after seeing outcomes cannot rescue a one-dimensional exact nesting model.
The appropriate successor is mechanism-level localization of inversion witnesses and reconstruction of the smallest context/search-state susceptibility basis, not a softer post-hoc scalar ranking.
claim_ceiling: Do not infer Elo/playing-strength order from preference-survival rates.

Do not infer that all engine susceptibility is intrinsically multidimensional in every ecology; P19 rejects the tested exact one-dimensional ordered-threshold representation on these fresh event worlds.
Do not treat Ferrers obstruction as identification of an internal search mechanism.
Do not rescue H1 by reordering engines or tolerating a small violation rate post hoc.
Do not rescue H2 by changing literals or thresholds.
